posts.title: Vote kick
posts.html: I know voting is kind of a big part in other RP games, but if you guys were to have JUST ONE type of vote, I think it should be votekick. In Experiment you can get shot in the head for looking at someone, following someone, jumping near them, being alone on the street with them, etc.
